method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the duties in ss 63, 65, 66 and 78B are regulative rules (PARTY ... MUST/SHANT ... HENCE ... LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE) with no WITHIN, the Act setting no time; no REFUSE (gaps answer `not covered` or NOTHING, asserted); every satisfaction or determination of a court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. Beside baseline-2026-10 (the accused's seat), which is unchanged. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Judiciary Act 1903, the compilation registered as C2024C00864 (Compilation No. 51, compilation date 2024-12-11; Federal Register of Legislation, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1903A00006.txt. No instrument brought in.

checks.command: l4 run jc-claimant.l4 ; l4 run jc-cases-claimant.l4
checks.result: 121 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; 5 #TRACEs as their expect lines say (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A breached DEONTIC cannot be compared with EQUALS on this l4, so traces are asserted through a CONSIDER ... WHEN FULFILLED helper and breaches are #TRACEd.

scope: From the claimant's seat (a civil claim against the Commonwealth, a State or a Commonwealth officer, or in federal jurisdiction; and being sued by the Commonwealth): s 39B(1), (1A), (1B)-(1EA), (1F)(a), (2); s 44(1), (2) for a treaty matter (s 38(a)), (2A), (3); ss 55ZG(3), 55ZI; s 56(1), (2); s 58; s 60; ss 63-67; s 67E; s 77MA(1)-(4) (commencement 22 Nov 1984; (2)(c) answered NOTHING, (2)(d) a saving, recorded); s 77N; ss 78AA, 78B(1), (2)(c), (3)(b), (5); s 79(1), (1A)(b), (2)-(4); s 80A; ss 82, 83. Out: Parts I-V except s 44 (High Court procedure and appeals, incl. ss 25A, 26, 27); ss 38-39A; s 39B(1F)(b); ss 40-43, 45; s 44(2) for s 38(b)-(d) matters, s 44(4); Part VIII; Part VIIIA except ss 55ZG(3), 55ZI; ss 57, 59, 61, 62; Part IXA except s 67E; Part X (see baseline-2026-10); ss 77M, 77P-77V; ss 78, 78A; s 78B(2)(a), (b), (3)(a), (4); s 80 (encoded in baseline-2026-10); ss 81, 84-88; the content of State and Territory law.
